import re, collections
from decimal import Decimal
SRC = r"C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\prompt-evals-session-r9wy_qpe\personal_expenses.txt"
MON = {'jan':1,'feb':2,'mar':3,'apr':4,'may':5,'jun':6,'jul':7,'aug':8,'sep':9,'oct':10,'nov':11,'dec':12}
DATE_PATS = [
    (r'\b2026-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b', lambda m:(int(m[1]),int(m[2]))),
    (r'\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})(?:/26)?\b', lambda m:(int(m[1]),int(m[2]))),
    (r'\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b', lambda m:(int(m[1]),int(m[2]))),
    (r'\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|June?|July?|Aug(?:ust)?|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b', lambda m:(MON[m[1][:3].lower()],int(m[2]))),
]
AMT = re.compile(r'(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})\s*\)?\s*$|(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})')
CATS = [
 ('Dining & Coffee', ["Local Coffee Co","Starbucks","Chipotle","McDonald's","Rustic Tap Brewery","Panera Bread","Sushi Kame","Thai Orchid","Bagel Corner","Luigi's Pizza"]),
 ('Shopping', ["Amazon","Target","Best Buy","Old Navy","REI","IKEA","Home Depot","Barnes & Noble"]),
 ('Groceries', ["Trader Joe's","Aldi","Kroger","Costco","Whole Foods"]),
 ('Gas & Auto', ["Shell","Chevron","BP Gas","Jiffy Lube"]),
 ('Transport & Parking', ["Lyft","Uber","City Parking Authority"]),
 ('Subscriptions & Bills', ["iCloud+ 200GB","Amazon Prime","Netflix","Spotify Premium","Planet Fitness App","Xfinity Internet","Verizon Wireless"]),
 ('Fitness', ["Planet Fitness"]),
 ('Health & Pharmacy', ["Riverside Physical Therapy","Dr. Hensley Dental Copay","Walgreens","CVS Pharmacy"]),
 ('Entertainment', ["Steam","Spotify Concert","AMC Theatres","Bowl-O-Rama","Ticketmaster"]),
 ('Travel', ["Delta Air Lines","Airport Parking","Marriott","Hertz Rental Car"]),
 ('Uncategorized', ["Zelle Payment","ATM Cash Withdrawal","Venmo - Sam","PayPal Transfer"]),
]
# longest names first so "Amazon Prime" beats "Amazon", "Planet Fitness App" beats "Planet Fitness"
MERCH = sorted(((n,c) for c,ns in CATS for n in ns), key=lambda x:-len(x[0]))

rows, bad = [], []
for ln, line in enumerate(open(SRC, encoding='utf-8'), 1):
    s = line.strip()
    if ln < 4 or not s: continue
    merch = next(((n,c) for n,c in MERCH if n in s), None)
    rest = s.replace(merch[0], ' ') if merch else s
    date = None
    for p,f in DATE_PATS:
        m = re.search(p, rest)
        if m: date = f(m); rest = rest[:m.start()]+' '+rest[m.end():]; break
    am = re.findall(r'(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})', rest)
    if not merch or not date or len(am)!=1:
        bad.append((ln,s)); continue
    sign = -1 if (am[0][0] or am[0][1]) else 1
    amt = Decimal(am[0][2])*sign
    refund = s.lower().startswith('return') or amt < 0
    rows.append(dict(ln=ln, month=date[0], day=date[1], merchant=merch[0], cat=merch[1], amt=amt, refund=refund, raw=s))

print("UNPARSED:", bad)
print("PARSED:", len(rows), "of", sum(1 for i,l in enumerate(open(SRC,encoding='utf-8'),1) if i>=4 and l.strip()))

# duplicates: same merchant, amount, date
seen, dups = {}, []
for r in rows:
    k = (r['merchant'], r['amt'], r['month'], r['day'])
    if k in seen: dups.append((seen[k], r)); r['dup']=True
    else: seen[k]=r; r['dup']=False
print("EXACT DUPLICATES:", [(a['ln'],b['ln'],b['raw']) for a,b in dups])
# near-duplicates: same merchant within 2 days
near=[]
for i,a in enumerate(rows):
